events.title: Relocat at DevGAMM Belgrade!

events.title: Relocat is coming November 10!
events.summary: We’re excited to share the official Relocat trailer—and announce that the game will be released on November 10, 2026! Watch the trailer to meet Inky and get a glimpse of the journey that awaits him in Boren.If you’d like to support the game, add Relocat to your wishlist and try the free demo. See you in November!

events.title: Devlog #3
events.summary: Hi everyone!Relocat will support both Xbox and PlayStation controllers.We’re currently adapting the controls, menus, and button prompts to make the game comfortable to play with a controller.Controller support will also be added to the demo in an upcoming update — coming very soon!

events.title: Relocat Demo Arrives This December
events.summary: Relocat is getting ready for its first big step.
